authority: This file freezes development payload/import semantics for coordinated implementation. It does not register an import, change any existing profile/ABI/envelope, enable native effects or authorize publication.

source.rules: types below preserve capabilities/schema/v1.json. New wrapper has this separate contract identity; existing schema and envelope hashes remain unchanged.

imports.unknown_module_name_signature: reject complete module validation; no arbitrary dispatch, callback, native pointer, selector, WASI or plugin lookup import
imports.status_domains: Import return codes are separate from C report statuses, typed capability failure codes and VM traps. A successful enqueue owns a token, not native authorization or success.

memory.required: one defined nonshared memory index0; offsets/lengths are unsigned i32 bit patterns
memory.bounds: check full non-wrapping ranges and non-overlap before copy or mutation; output_capacity0 requires output_offset<=memory byte length
memory.enqueue_atomicity: bounds/session/slot/byte-quota rejection writes nothing, allocates no request and advances no request generation; success snapshots arguments and writes one token atomically
memory.poll: pending writes length0 only; tooSmall writes required length only and retains result; success copies entire payload then consumes delivery exactly once; other rejection writes nothing; output range and length range must not overlap
memory.ownership: no retained guest/native pointers or guest-memory output from native completion callbacks; snapshots survive guest mutation/growth
memory.dispatch: imports do not block on actors/I/O; enqueue alone does not yield; requests drain only after their guest invocation returns successfully; queued calls from a trapping/cancelled/closed turn never start I/O
memory.cancellation: request token is scoped to current VM session and generation; cancel is per-request, separate from permanent whole-session cancellation; later cancellation cannot undo an admitted external effect
memory.generation: opaque i64 bits: high32 nonzero generation, low32 slot+1; retire instead of wrapping; no guest-selectable originating session identity

json.encoding: valid UTF-8; one JSON object followed only by optional JSON whitespace; no BOM/comments/trailing value
json.depth_counting: root object counts1; at most8 simultaneously nested objects/arrays; scalar leaves do not add containers
json.value_counting: count root and each array/object value including collections; object keys do not count as values
json.unknown_fields: reject at every object; all listed fields mandatory, including empty arrays and empty base64 strings
json.duplicate_keys: reject before dictionary decoding after JSON escape/surrogate decoding; no Unicode normalization
json.numbers: canonical unsigned decimal UInt32 tokens only: 0 or [1-9][0-9]*, <=4294967295; reject signs, leading zeros, fractions, exponents, strings and booleans in numeric fields; then apply field bounds
json.booleans: true or false tokens only in bool fields; reject0/1/string/null coercion
json.unicode: reject invalid UTF-8, lone/unpaired surrogates and malformed escapes; well-formed escapes may spell ASCII field names/values; do not normalize; typed identifiers/header/URL text are ASCII as specified below; opaque application Unicode/binary bytes cross as base64
json.key_order: decode ignores key order; owned encoder emits sorted keys and unescaped slashes; escape spelling is not a signature or normalization authority
json.base64: RFC4648 standard alphabet, canonical padded encoding with correct zero pad bits; decode then re-encode must equal input exactly; empty is valid; maximum values below count decoded bytes, never encoded characters; no whitespace/URL-safe alphabet/missing padding

arguments.root: exact operation-specific argument object only, with no wrapper
arguments.routing: operation enum/import fixes capability, schema hash, operation and argument type; no operation/hash/identity/session/token/native implementation/grant/callback field appears in arguments
arguments.type_fields: each named type is an exact closed object with every field mandatory; Header name/value and all list elements are validated; arrays never accept dictionaries/null

rules.identifier: ASCII1..maximum bytes; only A-Z a-z0-9 hyphen underscore; case-sensitive; no slash/dot/path components; no normalization
rules.ascii: printable ASCII U+0020..U+007E only; may be empty unless another rule forbids it; field maximum counts UTF-8 bytes
rules.headers: 0..32 Header objects, unique exact decoded lowercase names; same Header type for arguments/results; no case folding to repair invalid input
rules.headerName: ASCII1..64 bytes, only lowercase a-z0-9 hyphen; deny host, connection, content-length, transfer-encoding, proxy-authorization, proxy-authenticate, cookie, set-cookie
rules.httpsURL: ASCII1..4096 bytes beginning exact lowercase https://; all URL bytes U+0021..U+007E, no # or backslash; authority ends at slash/question; lowercase DNS-style labels1..63 bytes, total hostname<=253, only a-z0-9 hyphen with no leading/trailing hyphen; no empty label, userinfo or IPv6; optional canonical nonzero UInt16 port excluding443; percent escapes require two uppercase hex digits; preserve path/query bytes exactly
rules.origin: https:// plus exact validated authority, excluding path/query; installed and signed release origin/method sets intersect exactly, never wildcard/path prefix/case normalization
rules.namespace: same identifier rule, exact case-sensitive grant namespace; keys are identifiers, never filesystem paths

completion.routing: capability/schemaHash/operation must exactly match expectedOperation enum and its fixed table entry, not arbitrary caller strings; unknown or mismatched fields reject before returning any outcome
completion.identity: no identity, session, token, UUID, slot, generation or native pointer in payload; caller retains originating VM session/token context externally

outcomes.value: typed result object of expected operation, validated through generated CapabilityResult.decode

outcomes.meaning: copied arguments failed strict typed decode before native dispatch; this is not an extra capability-v1 failure code

no_additional_cross_field_rules: KVGetResponse(found=false,valueBase64=nonempty canonical bytes) is type-valid; native store normally emits empty for missing, but codec must not invent a dependency
HTTPResponse status100..599 including3xx is type-valid; actual CapabilityHost rejects3xx with redirectDenied
KVMutationResponse committed=false is type-valid and is not coerced to failure
HTTP method/body/status combinations do not acquire extra codec restrictions absent schema v1

native_policy.authority: payload validity never grants authority; native registry/configuration plus installed and verified signed release grants must bind one originating session, then permissions/origins/methods/namespaces intersect before I/O

http.redirects: host/adapter reject3xx and redirect callbacks before any follow-up; type codec still accepts3xx

storage.namespace: exact installed and signed grant intersection
storage.commit: cancellation before precommit check aborts; once commit starts effect may remain; re-read resolves uncertainty

native_policy.failures: fixed capability codes only; no native exception text/credentials; cancellation/deadline/close do not assert rollback or exactly-once effects

proposed_sdk_api.status: declarations only; not implemented or exported by this commit
proposed_sdk_api.operation_enum: public enum GuestCapabilityOperationV1: UInt32, CaseIterable, Sendable { case httpRequest = 1, storageGet = 2, storagePut = 3, storageDelete = 4 }
proposed_sdk_api.rejection_enum: public enum GuestCapabilityRejectionV1: String, Equatable, Sendable { case invalidArguments }
proposed_sdk_api.outcome_enum: public enum GuestCapabilityCompletionV1: Equatable, Sendable { case success(CapabilityResult), failure(CapabilityFailure), rejected(GuestCapabilityRejectionV1) }
signatures: public static func decodeArguments(_ data: Data, operation: GuestCapabilityOperationV1) throws -> CapabilityOperation
public static func encodeArguments(_ operation: CapabilityOperation) throws -> Data
public static func decodeCompletion(_ data: Data, expectedOperation: GuestCapabilityOperationV1) throws -> GuestCapabilityCompletionV1
public static func encodeCompletion(_ outcome: GuestCapabilityCompletionV1, operation: GuestCapabilityOperationV1) throws -> Data
implementation_rules: Reuse CapabilityCodec.decodeObject/encodeObject internally; do not decode public DTOs through an unchecked raw Codable path
Map fixed enum to generated CapabilityOperation.decode/wire and CapabilityResult.decode/wire; no public arbitrary capability/hash/operation strings
Encoding arguments derives operation from CapabilityOperation and revalidates it before returning bounded data
Encoding completion binds success result case/schema to operation; validate failure/rejection variants and exact wrapper; never permit wrong-operation success
Bridge first uses existing CapabilityCodec.decodeCompletion(data, expected: actualCapabilityCall), then converts validated native outcome into new wrapper

Keep existing call/cancel/completion envelopes, signatures and hashes unchanged; rejected is only a new transport outcome; decoding failures throw CapabilityWireError rather than a native capability error
No token/session routing check is claimed by a value-only codec; mailbox/bridge must retain/check originating context externally

fixtures.oracle: existing public capability-probe over original raw argument objects/outcomes embedded in existing signed-independent capability envelopes; no JSON parser repairs duplicate/numeric/base64/Unicode bytes
fixtures.new_wrapper_fixture_status: not implemented; expected acceptance/meaning is contract data, not executed success
fixtures.scope: offline public-codec observations only, no Wasm/native mailbox/import/bridge/activation/release/Swiftasync/device qualification

preservation: No old profile, schema, SDK/VM/header, runtime identity, signed release contract or activation implementation is changed. Identity-v2/release-v3 implementation remains unauthorized.
